reviews.reasons: EXECUTABLE is supported. The member (quilt-shop workbook, cop_f8c95c4e3e9a42799c69) has every link on EVIDENCE facts of its own record: 1,100 shops with published owner emails in the national directory, 200 contacted and 900 not; a real purchase price ($149 paid by 16 owners, processor report Nov 10-24); conversion measured on this offer's own first send from the same directory (16/200 = 8%); Brain fulfils (PRODUCE_SPREADSHEET proved); $3 cost; $0 exposure. Recomputed: 28 x $149 = $4,172 >= $4,000 (27 would give $4,023); 28/900 = 3.1% needed vs 8% measured (~72 expected; even the ~5% lower bound of a 200-contact sample gives ~45). Timing with Nov 28 = day 0: emails days 1-5, payment within 7 days (by day 12), payout 3 days later (by day 15) of 30. The $84 cost is paid from settled receipts, so no capital. Ledger matches the steps and trace. Exclusions are right: the Harbor Point RFQ pays net 30 from delivery (~Jan 12, timeToFirstCash 45 days) after the deadline and has no win rate; the travel-nurse $2,400/week is a nurse pay survey, not a price a hospital pays, and MedBridge gave no quote.
findings: Recomputed: $4,172 gross, $84 direct cost, $4,088 net, settled by day 15 of 30.
Required 3.1% vs measured 8% on the same directory and same offer; population and channel match exactly.
Excluded travel-nurse opening: the price fact is a wage benchmark (what nurses are paid), not what a hospital pays for a placement (NOT_A_PURCHASE); fulfilment has no quote. Correctly excluded.
Excluded RFQ: settlement ~45 days, outside 30; one award with no close rate. Correctly excluded.

Operational note: SEND_A_MESSAGE is NOT_CONNECTED and DISCOVER_LOCAL_BUSINESSES UNREAD; the day-1 send to 900 needs the sending connector live (and volume at deliverable rates) or the 7-day payment clock starts later; ~15 days of slack absorb this.
